notes.title: A Gift of War Postponed!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

A Gift of War is postponed indefinitely.
I do want to create this game at some point.
However, right now I am working on a new game called Burial Stone.
It's a VR RPG game that plays kind of like Legend of Grimrock or like Lands of Lore or Eye of the Beholder.

I am sorry if you are disappointed, but a Gift of War will have to wait for another day.

Meanwhile you can look for Burial Stone at [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/burial-stone]https://www.indiedb.com/games/burial-stone[/url].

I will also create a Steam Page for Burial Stone, but this game will surely release. As I am already progressing quite a lot with it, and I think it will do well.
